key.name: corner-radius
key.description: 0 disables the mask. 22 matches the Hermes Local squircle. Higher values are rounder. The maximum is 40 so icons that are already circular are not cropped.

key.name: only-square
key.summary: Skip icons that are already shaped
key.description: Do not clip an icon when its corner pixels are already transparent.

key.name: only-webapps
key.description: When true, only installed web apps are rounded. When false, every hard-square icon is rounded.

key.name: extra-ids
key.description: Desktop file ids or prefixes to treat as web apps, in addition to Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Yandex Browser, GNOME Web and Firefox web apps.
